tasks.action: Decide whether a separate Shenron API process is justified by measurements and singleton job behavior; keep MCP, RAG, LLM and crawler in Aphrody
tasks.doneWhen: Decision records measured benefit, memory cost and migration gate; prototype only if justified
tasks.rationale: Measurements in docs/shenron/measurements/bot-profile-report.json prove that event loop delay remains under 2ms (p99 6.17ms under extreme worker indexing) and API latency p50 remains 0.15ms. A separate process would duplicate DI containers adding ~140MB RSS overhead without measurable latency gains. Option C hybrid runtime remains ratified.
